changeSet.comment: The sample table held only sample rows (Draft, Submitted), which don't fit the new columns, so they are deleted.

changeSet.author: waste-submit-reg
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE pkg_submission_cycle ( id uuid NOT NULL CONSTRAINT pk_pkg_submission_cycle PRIMARY KEY, packaging_submission_id uuid NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_pkg_submission_cycle_submission REFERENCES pkg_packaging_submission (id), cycle_number integer NOT NULL, -- True when an earlier cycle was accepted. Only a resubmission has a fee. is_resubmission boolean NOT NULL, opened_at timestamptz NOT NULL, -- Resubmissions only. PLACEHOLDER for the fee step: the reference of the payment for this cycle's fee. -- The payment itself will be held in the payment table ported from epr-payment-service. payment_reference varchar(100), payment_recorded_at timestamptz, -- The submission to the regulator. submitted_file_id is a pkg_submission_file row of this cycle. submitted_file_id uuid, submitted_by_user_id uuid, submitted_by varchar(200), submitted_at timestamptz, -- The regulator's decision, which closes the cycle. decision varchar(20) CONSTRAINT ck_pkg_submission_cycle_decision CHECK (decision IN ('Accepted', 'Rejected')), decision_comments varchar(4000), decided_by_user_id uuid, decided_at timestamptz, CONSTRAINT uq_pkg_submission_cycle_number UNIQUE (packaging_submission_id, cycle_number) );
